findings.reason: في السر الذي قام به الميم: الميم is the subject of قام and به refers to the secret; mim stands by that secret, not a secret established by mim.

findings.reason: وَمَا سَوَّلَ uses active سَوَّلَ, not passive سُوِّلَ; preserve the readable odd wording without reversing its voice.
وَمَا سَوَّلَ uses an active verb, not a passive verb; dibujuk reverses that voice.
يَا حَيَائِيلَ contains the vocative invocation يا, which must be translated rather than retained as part of the name.

findings.reason: صمد starts with ṣād, represented by Ṣ, not Ṥ (an s with acute and dot above); the same Name earlier on this page is correctly Ṣamad.
